name: Tanjong Pagar
summary: EWL CBD-south stop — office gravity, shophouse food edges, and dense condo stock with weekday peak crowds as the daily tax.
body: Tanjong Pagar is the shortlist when East-West Line CBD-south access and a mix of office towers plus shophouse food matter. Housing is mostly condo and serviced-apartment stock rather than quiet HDB heartland; weekday lunch and evening office crowds are the tax. Expats land here for door-to-desk speed and car-light living, not cul-de-sac calm. Compare with Outram for multi-line interchange optionality, Chinatown for deeper heritage tourist energy, and Marina Bay / CBD when you are already paying core premiums and want the skyline walk.

car-light households okay with weekday peak crowds

people who will book ActiveSG tables instead of trusting condo games rooms
